summary: Defines an experimental extension to IKEv2 that lets an IKE Security Association be created and authenticated using the EAP Re-authentication Protocol described in RFC 6696. It updates RFC 5996.

eli5.summary: If you already showed your ID once, this lets you get back into a secure room quickly with a shortcut, instead of showing it all over again.

questions: how to use eap re-authentication with ikev2
